title: Products
description: The products you sell: stock code, price, the branches selling them and stock per branch.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view products.
load_failed: Products could not be loaded. Try again.
empty_description: Add your first product; goods in and sales are recorded on its card.
empty_filtered_description: Change the filters or clear the search.
create_description: Set the product's stock code, price and the branches selling it.
edit_description: Update the catalog name, codes and prices. Stock only changes through stock movements.
detail_description: Catalog values, variants, branch stock and movements of the product.
detail_not_found: The product was not found or you have no access to it.
columns.name: Name
form.section_identity_desc: Name, stock code, barcode, unit and visibility.
form.section_price_desc: Sale price and purchase cost; branches may set their own price.
form.section_stock_desc: The product shows as low once available stock reaches this level.
form.section_branches_desc: Branches selling the product; later they change on the detail page.
fields.name: Product name
fields.name_hint: The name customers and the team see.
fields.sku_hint: Unique in the business; no spaces.
fields.barcode_hint: Optional; finds the product with a scanner.
fields.unit_hint: Stock is counted in this unit.
fields.description_hint: Optional; shown in the online shop.
fields.price_hint: Used where a branch sets no price of its own.
fields.low_stock_threshold_hint: With 0 the alert only shows when stock runs out.
fields.branches_hint: A sale is recorded only in a branch where the product is open.
fields.show_online_hint: Listed in the online shop and the mobile app.
fields.is_active_hint: An inactive product cannot be sold; its stock is kept.

validation.barcode_max: The barcode may have at most 64 characters.
validation.price: Enter a valid amount (at most 2 decimals).
validation.low_stock: Enter a whole number between 0 and 1,000,000.
validation.sort_order: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100,000.
validation.quantity: Enter a whole number between 1 and 100,000.
validation.reason_max: The reason may have at most 200 characters.
errors.insufficient_stock: Not enough stock; stock cannot go below zero.
errors.not_offered: The product is not on sale in this branch.
errors.inactive: An inactive product cannot be sold.
errors.has_stock: A record with stock cannot be deleted; bring its stock to zero first.
errors.taken: This value is already in use.
errors.same_branch: The target branch must differ from the source branch.
errors.future: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.not_found: Not found or you have no access to it.
quick_edit.title: Quick edit
stock.empty_description: Record the first goods in; branch stock shows here.
variants.description: Options such as size, color or volume. A product with variants keeps its stock on the variants.
variants.dialog_description: An empty price or cost uses the product's.
variants.first_variant_hint: The first variant needs the product's own stock at zero; stock then lives on the variants.
variants.empty_description: A product with a single kind needs no variants.
variants.fields.name: Variant name
variants.fields.price_hint: Left empty, the product's value applies.
variants.fields.is_active_hint: An inactive variant cannot be sold.
offers.dialog_description: An empty price uses the catalog price.
offers.empty_description: Add the product to a branch to record sales.
offers.fields.price_hint: Left empty, the catalog price applies.
offers.fields.is_active_hint: When off, no sale can be recorded in this branch.
image.title: Product image
image.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP; at most 5 MB.
image.remove_description: The product is listed without an image.
image.too_large: The image may be at most 5 MB.
movements.title: Stock movements
movements.description: The stock ledger of your branches: goods in, sales, returns, counts and transfers. Entries are never edited; a correction is a new movement.
movements.load_failed: Stock movements could not be loaded. Try again.
movements.empty_filtered_description: Change the filters or clear the search.
movements.product_empty_description: No stock movement for this product yet.
movements.dialog_description: Scan a barcode or search the product; stock cannot go below zero.
movements.fields.counted_hint: System stock: {{on_hand}}; the difference is written as a count.
movements.fields.unit_price_hint: Left empty, the branch or catalog price applies.
movements.fields.unit_cost_hint: Left empty, the product's cost applies.
movements.fields.occurred_at_hint: Left empty, now; cannot be in the future.
movements.toast.returned: Product taken back; the sale was reversed.
movements.return.title: Take back a sale
movements.return.description: {{quantity}} × {{product}} go back into {{branch}} stock and the sale's revenue is reversed.
movements.return.money_hint: No money was collected for this sale, so nothing is paid back. Correct damaged stock with a count afterwards.
movements.return.reason_max: The reason can be at most 200 characters.
movements.return.note_max: The note can be at most 2000 characters.
movements.collection.toggle_hint: The sale amount goes into the chosen till or bank account. Off, the sale is recorded unpaid; the money can be taken later.
movements.collection.no_accounts: This branch has no open till or bank account. Open one in the cash module, or record the sale without money.
movements.collection.account_placeholder: Choose a till or bank account
movements.collection.amount_hint: Empty takes the whole sale amount. The rest can be collected later.
movements.collect.title: Take money
movements.collect.description: Take all or part of the {{remaining}} still owed for the {{product}} sale.
movements.collect.amount_hint: At most what is still owed.
movements.refund.title: Refund money
movements.refund.description: Up to {{refundable}} can be paid back for the {{product}} sale. The money leaves the chosen account.
movements.return.refund_toggle_hint: {{amount}} was collected for this sale. On, the money is paid back in the same step as the return.
movements.return.refund_amount_hint: Empty pays back everything that was collected.
movements.return.money_later_hint: {{amount}} was collected for this sale. It is not paid back in this step; use "Refund money" after the return.

validation.amount_over_remaining: The amount cannot exceed what is still owed.
validation.amount_over_refundable: The amount cannot exceed what can be refunded.
validation.account_required: Choose a till or bank account.
validation.note_max: The note can be at most 240 characters.
